name: ECE 3225
title: Optical Engineering Laboratory
description: Hands-on design and measurement of optical systems and components. Lens systems and imaging, fiber-optic communications and fiber-optic sensors, diffraction and Fourier Optics, interferometry, etc. Structured experiments and design projects centered on available equipment.
requirement_description: ECE 3223, which may be taken concurrently; open only to students in the School of Engineering.
